what: PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I, lead analyst synthesis of the lenses conviction, clock and weights and of the attack on V05. IN SAMPLE ONLY: price frames read with the parquet row filter ts < 2022-01-01; official trades read with entry_time < 2022-01-01 and exit_time < 2022-01-01 in the read; context-lens tables read with t_dec < 2022-01-01; nothing dated 2022 or later was read, simulated or looked at. account_convention: PLAIN SUM of the one-position chains of the sleeves (no 6-position / 2-per-market caps, no compounding), 1 R per trade times the stake; kept the same throughout. Chains: orders of the frozen rules from lab/r2/recalc.py::sleeves() on the in-sample slice, simulated with no_overlap, orders whose stop is closer than 3 spreads of the fill bar refused (sleeve re-simulated), trades still open at the end of the slice dropped. FP server weeks (New York + 7 h, Monday to Sunday); stake x R booked in the week of the EXIT; every calendar week counts (empty = 0). Out-of-fold window: the 157 server weeks whose Thursday falls in 2019, 2020 or 2021; a week belongs to the year of its Thursday. Weekly Sharpe = mean / sd (ddof 1) x sqrt(52). each variant's stakes are multiplied by k = sd(reference weekly R) / sd(variant weekly R) over the 157 out-of-fold weeks (same cost mode); every measure of the variant is then read at that scale. Per-year figures use the same k.

The workflow rule keeps ONLY changes whose verdict is confirmed or weakened with a positive effect: a necessary condition, not a sufficient one; the candidate criteria of Addendum I remain binding.

growth_meaning.kept_set: Addendum I keeps nothing: the weekly Sharpe at equal swing is unchanged (x1.00), so is the growth.
growth_meaning.rule: At equal weekly swing the mean weekly gain moves in proportion to the weekly Sharpe. A compounding account staked at a fixed fraction of its optimal (Kelly) stake grows at a rate proportional to the square of the Sharpe. At a fixed fall over a long horizon (expected deepest fall about stake x variance / mean), the stake can rise about in proportion to the Sharpe and the gain about with its square; over a short horizon such as one month the falls come from the swing, so the stake cannot rise and the gain rises only in proportion to the Sharpe. In these samples the deepest fall at equal swing is noisy: K1+K2+K3 has a higher Sharpe and a deeper fall (24.1 R against 21.0 R).

proposed_validation_look: DECLARATION for the single look at 2022-2025 (PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I, lead synthesis; written 2026-11-12 before any 2022+ row is read by this synthesis, which reads none). 1. ADDENDUM I ADDS NO CHANGE. No conviction, clock or weight rule survived the criteria fixed in Addendum I and the attack, so none enters the look. FROZEN for Addendum I: every trade of every sleeve keeps a stake of 1 base stake (1 R); nothing is fitted, so nothing is refitted on 1 January 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025. V05 (the pooled crypto ridge, x1.095 in sample, below the x1.10 bar), IV00 and every other variant of the three lenses are excluded and may not be added to the look, before or after any 2022+ result. 2. THE ONE LOOK covers exactly the kept changes of Addendum H, each as declared by its synthesis, at most one change per sleeve: K1, K2 and K3 as declared in results/r2/autopsy/synthesis_B.json (K1: brk72_24h_wd ethusd skips a signal when 10,000 x stop_dist / P >= T(Y); T(2022) = 478.28 bp, the 2/3 quantile of the riskbp of the 2345 in-sample signals decided before 2021-12-25, each taken alone with FP costs, whose upper third averaged -0.131 R against +0.342 R for the lower third; refitted each 1 January Y on the signals decided before 1 January Y minus 7 days, the worse third skipped only if it lost; with costs x1.5 the same procedure on the x1.5 labels (T(2022) = 478.28 bp); K2 and K3: orb_asia_2d_buf10 unchanged on ethusd and btcusd), with synthesis_B's comparisons and criteria unchanged; plus the changes that synthesis_A keeps, if its declaration is complete before the look is run. 3. READING ADDED BY ADDENDUM I, NOT A CRITERION (so that the gain per unit of swing is on file): on the plain sum of the one-position chains (3-spread refusal; trades open at 2025-12-31 23:59 dropped), FP server weeks booked at the exit, every week of 2022-2025 counted, the weekly Sharpe of (i) the ten unchanged and (ii) the portfolio with every kept change of Addendum H (new sleeves included), (ii) scaled so that its weekly standard deviation over 2022-2025 equals (i)'s; pooled and for each year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025; FP costs and costs x1.5 (frames and orders rebuilt); with trades, R per trade, euros earned per 100 euros risked, total R, share of losing weeks, worst week, longest run of losing weeks and losing trades per month. 4. EXPECTATIONS declared now, not targets: for Addendum I, none (no change). On this measure the in-sample H set (K1+K2+K3 against the ten, 2019-2021, FP) gave x1.123 (2019 x1.322, 2020 x1.043, 2021 x1.015), mostly 2019; the verifiers' forward estimates are +0.03 to +0.06 R per trade for K1 (possibly zero), +0.15 to +0.25 for K2, +0.10 to +0.16 for K3 (zero plausible). 5. CRITERIA: Addendum I has none, since nothing of it is in the look; each change of Addendum H is judged by the criteria of its own declaration. The 2026 holdout stays untouched. A failure is final: nothing is re-tuned, re-declared or looked at again.
summary_for_the_user_fr:
Réponse : non. Miser plus sur les trades « qui ont des chances » n'apporte pas assez ; rien n'est retenu.
Testé sur 2019-2021 seulement, à risque hebdomadaire égal : mise selon le contexte, l'heure, le jour, ou par règle.
Heure et jour : rien (de -7 % à 0 % de gain à risque égal). Mise par règle : +6 % au mieux, 2019 en baisse.
Meilleure idée : 1,5 mise sur les cassures crypto bien notées, 0,5 ou 0 ailleurs : +9,5 % ; il fallait +10 %.
Ce gain vient presque tout de 2021 (+34 %) ; 2019 : +0,6 % ; 2018 va dans l'autre sens (-6 %).
Avec le filtre éther déjà retenu, elle n'ajoute que +6 %, et 2019 baisse.
Sur 1 000 € aux prix actuels, les petites mises passent sous le lot minimum : -5 %.
Le portefeuille reste celui d'avant : 2019-2021, 14 € gagnés pour 100 € risqués, 45 % de semaines perdantes, pire semaine -13 mises.
Doubler en un mois avec des chutes sous 20 % demande 35 € pour 100 € risqués au lieu de 8 (2022-2025), soit 4,4 fois plus : on reste à 1.
Seul levier qui bouge un peu : ajouter des règles, comme deux règles « Asie » sur crypto (essai précédent) : +12 %, surtout 2019, pire chute plus profonde.
Tout vient des années qui ont servi à bâtir les règles : c'est optimiste.
Suite : le seul test 2022-2025 déjà prévu, sans mise variable.
ideas_that_do_not_work: Stakes or skips by hour band or weekday (clock lens, 9 declared rules): x0.933 to x1.000 pooled weekly Sharpe at equal swing, 2019-2021, FP (x0.952 to x0.998 with costs x1.5), up in at most 1 of 3 years. Even stakes set with perfect hindsight of each year (x1.18 hour bands, x1.38 weekdays) stay below the median of the same bound on randomly shuffled labels (x1.22, x1.41): the clock carries no more structure than noise.

One stake per sleeve (weights lens, 15 variants): walk-forward mean/variance x0.938 to x0.985; inverse volatility x1.007 to x1.059 with 2019 down at every shrinkage (IV00: 2019 x0.859, 2020 x1.074, 2021 x1.297); switching a sleeve off while its trailing 12/24/36-month expectancy is not positive x0.959 to x0.990 (the 24-month switch turned off 459 trades that made +56.4 R); rank weights D4-D7 x0.919 to x0.981. Even the best static weights chosen with hindsight of 2019-2021 give only +24.6 %.

Per-sleeve terciles of one descriptor with 0 / 0.5 / 1.5 stakes (conviction V01-V04, V23-V28): x0.942 to x1.047 FP; on the six non-crypto sleeves every per-sleeve rule lowered the R (230.5 R to 149-218 R, 2019-2021); the chosen descriptor drifts from year to year; V04's permutation null reaches it in 29.5 % of draws.

Bigger stakes when another sleeve holds the same side of the same market (V11-V15): x0.952 to x0.997 FP; its null reaches V11 in 59.5 % of draws. The +0.24 R vs +0.14 R seen by the cluster lens does not hold out of fold.
Combining the pooled ridge with per-sleeve rules (V16-V20): x1.018 to x1.061, worse than the ridge alone; a per-sleeve ridge for all ten (V10, 8 fitted parameters per sleeve): x1.007.

Cutting the trades 'with no chance' (V05's zero rule alone, verifier): x1.042; the 213 baseline crypto trades it removed made +5.5 R in total (+0.026 R each, my run: brk72 btc 30 trades +1.8 R, F1 eth 48 trades +13.2 R, brk72 eth 135 trades -9.5 R). What gains is the 1.5 stake on high scores, mostly in 2020-2021.

The best idea, the pooled crypto ridge V05: my re-simulation x1.095 (2019 x1.006, 2020 x1.047, 2021 x1.339) FP, x1.102 (2019 x1.010, 2020 x1.055, 2021 x1.340) with costs x1.5; strict training cut x1.100 (2019 x1.022, 2020 x1.047, 2021 x1.339); on top of K1 x1.056 (2019 x0.980, 2020 x1.040, 2021 x1.199); earlier 2018 fold x0.944 (verifier); on a 1,000 EUR account at today's prices as the live program would run it x0.954 at 1 % risk, x0.993 at 2 % (verifier). Not kept.
caveats: In sample only, on the years that built the ten rules (F1's scorecard was fitted on candidates up to 2021-12-27): every figure here, walk-forward included, is optimistic. The measure that counts is the validation look, then the demo account.

The kept set (none) was declared before any run of this synthesis (declared.json, 15:03 UTC). My runs reproduce the lens and verifier figures to the fourth decimal (V05 x1.0951, strict x1.1002, on K1 x1.0558, K1 x1.0359, reference 3,985 trades +556.16 R Sharpe 2.7466) and do not change it.

Account: plain sum of the one-position chains, 1 R x stake, no 6-position / 2-per-market caps, no compounding, no minimum lot. On the user's 1,000 EUR account many 0.5 stakes and BTC stakes fall under 0.01 lot (Addendum E); the verifier's live-like run of V05 there gives x0.954 at 1 % risk.

The H set measured here (K1+K2+K3, x1.123 (2019 x1.322, 2020 x1.043, 2021 x1.015) FP, k 0.8269) covers synthesis_B's changes only. Its gain sits in 2019; at equal swing its deepest weekly fall is 24.07 R against 21.03 R and its worst week -13.95 R against -12.54 R; K2 and K3 were chosen by the breadth lens on 2013-2021, so 2019-2021 is not out of sample for their selection; their edge per trade halved from 2018-2019 to 2020-2021; ethusd would carry three sleeves for two slots. synthesis_A (declared 15:12 UTC, in progress) may add other H changes to the look (ocm4 T1, F1 ethusd H2, brk72 btcusd S0.75r, donch4h_stop S0.75r, orb_asia_2d_buf10 S0.75r); they are not in these figures.

Rule 3's 7-day purge: in their 2019 fits V05 as declared uses two outcomes known exactly at the purge instant and K1 one outcome known a few hours after it (truncation test T1b); both fits are identical on frames cut at 1 January of the year they are used in (T1a), so neither sees the year it is applied to.
The FP frames' spread uses a day-median shape that is not causal; it affects fills and labels, not the descriptors of the stakes (riskbp replaces sprR).

The two gold trades entered on 2021-12-31 whose official exit is in 2022 were counted but not read, and are excluded everywhere. Weeks are FP server weeks booked at the exit and belong to the year of their Thursday; the 3,985 reference trades include a few entered in late December 2018 (the clock and weights lenses count 3,981 by entry).
Selection: the three lenses tried 30 + 15 + 15 variants and the verifier 77 lines; this synthesis ran 6 re-measurements x 2 cost modes (12 trial lines) and chose no parameter.
